Return a JSON object with keys company_name, industry, what_they_do, b2b_or_b2c, size_hint (one of solo, small, medium, large, unknown), and confidence (high, medium, or low). Use null for unknown fields. If the text is empty or unusable set confidence to low. Do not use outside knowledge. Return only JSON.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Website text: ' + (($('Fetch Homepage').item.json.data || '').toString().slice(0, 4000)) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a B2B lead scoring assistant. Return a JSON object with keys score (integer 0 to 100), tier (hot, warm, or cold), reasoning (two or three sentences), and suggested_action (one line).
